text:
emily: quick flag - onboarding run for magnet13b-int4-lite shows a subtle degradation only when we resume very long prefills (~9k tokens). putting short repro and notes here.

raj: numbers? is it latency or quality?

emily: quality. top-5 recall on long-anchor suite drops from 0.893 -> 0.870 (delta ~0.023) when using snapshot s-2026-07-09-rehydrateopt. Short contexts unaffected.

taylor: which change landed in that snapshot? prefill or rotary work?

emily: both. snapshot generation now applies "phase_compact" (compact rotary normalization) and we changed `kvcache_write_grain` to 32 to reduce snapshot size. suspect interaction with int4 accumulation ordering.

raj: can you paste the eval command? I'll run locally.

emily: repro: 
```
python eval/run_prefill_eval.py \
  --model magnet13b-int4-lite --snapshot s-2026-07-09-rehydrateopt \
  --prompt tests/anchors/long-anchor-09.txt --max-tokens 9216 \
  --kvcache-mode resume --quant-kernel int4 --emit-json
```
baseline top5 0.893, canary 0.870. quick logits snip: LOGITS_DIFF {"compact_phase_tail": 0.0026, "chunk_boundary_skew": 0.0011}.

taylor: try forcing `--disable-phase-compact` and `--kvcache-grain 64`?

emily: ran both. `--disable-phase-compact` -> 0.891, `--kvcache-grain 64` -> 0.890, both -> 0.892. so both knobs recover almost all of the loss.

debug-bot: Canary s-2026-07-09-rehydrateopt rolled to 3% at 2026-07-09T12:00:00Z. Alert: longctx_recall_drop=0.023.

raj: sounds like numeric interplay: compact normalization reduces headroom and small write-grain changes alter accumulation ordering. int4 kernels can amplify the tiny differences.

taylor: i'll add a small tool `tools/rehydrate_phase_probe` that compares expected phase vs rehydrated for each token and outputs histogram; run it across pre/post snapshots.

emily: ran that on canary: histogram shows 98.7% tokens within 1e-5, 1.0% in [1e-5,1e-3], 0.3% tail >1e-3 concentrated where writes straddle grain boundaries. artifact: s3://internal/artifacts/rehydrate_probe_1795554321.json

raj: proposed mitigation: 1) snapshot metadata: store phase_norm as float32 (low lift) 2) increase kvcache_write_grain back to 64 by default for snapshotting 3) add pre-commit rehydrate_phase_probe and block if tail > 1e-3. (emily/eng/qa)

taylor: i'll prototype the probe and a unit that simulates cross-grain accumulation order for int4 kernels. if order is non-deterministic we need a deterministic stitch rule.

qa-bot: queued regression run `prefill-rehydrate-sanity x3` on canary. CI: https://ci.redwood-internal/prefill/1795554321

emily: pausing any further rollouts of this snapshot until we get a parity gate. adding note to onboarding checklist.

raj: thanks. i'll help bisect the snapshot-gen commits to find exactly where phase_compact introduced the shift.

emily: appreciated. also adding nightly guard that runs the probe and uploads histogram to snapshot metadata so future rollouts fail fast.

taylor: will follow up with PR for float32 metadata and the probe integration.

emily: done for now.
